def _journal_review(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    source: dict[str, Any],
    parsed_records: int,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Project the existing parser and FIFO ledger; never infer account equity."""
    limit = 200
    unmatched: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    matched = pair_trades_fifo(df, unmatched=unmatched)
    names = dict(zip(df["symbol"], df["name"]))
    currencies = sorted({code_currency(symbol) for symbol in df["symbol"]})
    by_symbol: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for trade in matched:
        symbol = trade["symbol"]
        summary = by_symbol.setdefault(symbol, {
            "symbol": symbol, "name": names.get(symbol, ""),
            "currency": trade["currency"], "matched_count": 0,
            "matched_quantity": 0.0, "matched_pnl": 0.0,
        })
        summary["matched_count"] += 1
        summary["matched_quantity"] += trade["qty"]
        summary["matched_pnl"] += trade["pnl"]
    for summary in by_symbol.values():
        summary["matched_pnl"] = round(summary["matched_pnl"], 2)
    unmatched_symbols: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for lot in unmatched:
        key = (lot["symbol"], lot["side"])
        summary = unmatched_symbols.setdefault(key, {
            "symbol": lot["symbol"], "name": names.get(lot["symbol"], ""),
            "currency": lot["currency"], "side": lot["side"],
            "quantity": 0.0, "lots": 0,
        })
        summary["quantity"] += lot["quantity"]
        summary["lots"] += 1
    settlements = []
    for currency in currencies:
        pool = df[df["symbol"].map(code_currency) == currency]
        settlements.append({
            "currency": currency,
            "matched_pnl": round(sum(t["pnl"] for t in matched if t["currency"] == currency), 2),
            "recognized_fees": round(float(pool["fee"].sum()), 2),
            "record_count": len(pool),
        })
    valid_dates = df["datetime"].dropna()
    return {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "source_sha256": source["source_sha256"],
        "coverage": {
            **source,
            "parsed_records": parsed_records,
            "analyzed_records": len(df),
            "filtered_out_records": parsed_records - len(df),
            "buy_records": int((df["side"] == "buy").sum()),
            "sell_records": int((df["side"] == "sell").sum()),
            "dividend_records": int((df["side"] == "dividend").sum()),
            "invalid_datetime_records": int(df["datetime"].isna().sum()),
            "date_start": str(valid_dates.min().date()) if not valid_dates.empty else None,
            "date_end": str(valid_dates.max().date()) if not valid_dates.empty else None,
            "currencies": currencies,
        },
        "preview": {"rows": df.head(8).to_dict(orient="records"),
                    "total": len(df), "limit": 8, "truncated": len(df) > 8},
        "settlements": settlements,
        "by_symbol": list(by_symbol.values()),
        "matched_trades": {"rows": matched[:limit], "total": len(matched),
                           "limit": limit, "truncated": len(matched) > limit},
        "unmatched": {
            "rows": unmatched[:limit], "total_lots": len(unmatched),
            "limit": limit, "truncated": len(unmatched) > limit,
            "by_symbol": list(unmatched_symbols.values()),
        },
        "method": {
            "pairing": "fifo_with_short_lots",
            "opening_balance": "not_provided",
            "pnl_scope": "matched_trade_pnl_after_native_fee_allocation",
            "fee_scope": "recognized_parser_fee_columns_only",
            "currency_conversion": False,
            "account_return": False,
            "unmatched_scope": "remaining_imported_lots_not_account_positions",
            "short_scope": "native_sell_before_buy_pairing_not_proof_of_short_selling",
        },
    }
